name: 02446 · Brookline, MA
findings: ZIP 02446 (Brookline) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02446 (Brookline) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02446 (Brookline) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 46 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.
